title: [DEV] Autosens is shown on Overview even if disabled
body: [This](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/dev/plugins/main/src/main/java/info/nightscout/plugins/general/overview/OverviewFragment.kt#L1091) line of code makes aaps always draw Autosens data on overview screen as 'active', even if isAutosensModeEnabled() returns false.

comments.body:
And if you select dynISF the related figures are missing since a few days. 
Could that be related to the Autosens thing?
this is by design because it's calculated anyway. it's there to notify user some change can be usefull
